title: IPOs: Could China’s Next Tech Boom Surprise Wall Street?
summary: Could China's next generation of tech giants catch Wall Street off guard? From a resurgence in Chinese IPOs to breakthroughs in artificial intelligence, robotics, and semiconductors, a new wave of companies is drawing investor attention. Andrew Wilkinson sits down with Xiaolin Chen, Head of International at KraneShares, to explore what's fueling China's technology ambitions, why Hong Kong is reemerging as a major listing hub, and how improving US-China relations could reshape the investment landscape.
